# VEED

> VEED is an AI video generation and editing platform. Generate videos, avatars, voices and images with AI, then edit, subtitle, translate and dub video in the browser.

Pages on www.veed.io can be fetched as Markdown by sending `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Main sections

- [Ads & templates](https://www.veed.io/create)
- [Tools](https://www.veed.io/tools)
- [Enterprise](https://www.veed.io/contact-sales)
- [API](https://api.veed.io/)
- [Pricing](https://www.veed.io/pricing)

## AI Video

- [AI Video Generator](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-video)
- [Text to Video](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-video/text-to-video)
- [VideoGPT](https://www.veed.io/tools/video-gpt)
- [Image to Video](https://www.veed.io/tools/image-to-video-ai)
- [AI Video Editor](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-video/ai-video-editor)
- [AI Clip Generator](https://www.veed.io/tools/auto-video-editor/ai-clip-generator)
- [AI Script Generator](https://www.veed.io/tools/script-generator)

## AI Avatars & Lip Sync

- [AI Avatars](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-avatar)
- [AI Lip Sync](https://www.veed.io/tools/lip-sync-api)
- [Eye Contact AI](https://www.veed.io/tools/eye-tracking-software/eye-contact-ai)

## AI Voice & Audio

- [Remove Background Noise from Audio](https://www.veed.io/tools/remove-background-noise-from-audio)
- [Remove Background Noise from Video](https://www.veed.io/tools/remove-background-noise-from-video)

## AI Image

- [AI Image Generator](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-image-generator)
- [AI Image Editor](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-image-editor)
- [AI Background Remover](https://www.veed.io/tools/ai-background-remover)
- [Image Upscaler](https://www.veed.io/tools/image-upscaler)

## Make Ads

## Transcribe & Record

- [Audio to Text](https://www.veed.io/tools/audio-to-text)

- [Screen Recorder](https://www.veed.io/tools/screen-recorder)

- [Teleprompter](https://www.veed.io/tools/teleprompter)
- [Transcription](https://www.veed.io/tools/transcription)

## Pricing
